entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded. To track an order, press one. For technical support, press two. For returns or exchanges, press three.
Connecting you to the next available agent.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is David. How can I help you today?
I need to return the VeloBand Cadence Sensor. Order number is VF-882091.
Okay, let me pull that up for you. VF-882091. I see it here. To make sure I get you to the right place, can I ask what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?
Preference. I just need to know if I can return it or not. Yes or no.
I understand, you want to get this sorted out quickly. Let me just check the delivery date here... I see it arrived 18 days ago. One moment while I review the policy for this specific item.
Look, is it too late or not?
Not at all. I've confirmed it here. The VeloBand Cadence Sensor has a 90-day return window. Since you're only on day 18, you are well within the policy for a full refund.
Good. Send the shipping label to the email on file.

Absolutely. I have just processed the return authorization. You'll receive an email with the pre-paid shipping label and instructions within the next five minutes. Once we receive the item, your refund will be issued. Can I help with anything else today?
Great. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a good day.
